readerCopy.headline: A beautiful story can still need receipts.
readerCopy.body:
An offer, relationship, or plan may sound so good that the basic questions start feeling almost rude. Someone may be completely sincere and still not know the answer. A promise can be inspiring and still depend on money, timing, approval, or work nobody has assigned yet.

Jupiter square Neptune enlarges hope and uncertainty at the same time. Check what is confirmed, who is responsible, and what happens if the promise slips. You can believe in the possibility and still need evidence before you reorganize your life around it.
